__comment: DelightfulCompat neutralizer for oaksdelight:crafting/knives/iron_cleaver. oaksdelight 1.0.9 ships this path as an EMPTY 0-byte file (EOFException on load); the working recipe lives at oaksdelight:cleaver/iron and is what the advancement/JEI use. This override replaces the empty stub with a valid copy gated by an always-false condition, so the parse error vanishes WITHOUT registering a duplicate cleaver recipe. The cleaver itself remains craftable via the real recipe.
